title.zh: 【渣打银行签署最终协议，将全资收购加密托管机构 Zodia Custody】
title.en: 【渣打银行签署最终协议，将全资收购加密托管机构 Zodia Custody】

current_state.zh: Standard Chartered signed a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of crypto custodian Zodia Custody, folding its regulated custody business into the bank's financing and securities services division while spinning its institutional digital asset infrastructure platform into a separate SC Ventures entity, Zodia Solutions, pending regulatory approval.
current_state.en: Standard Chartered signed a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of crypto custodian Zodia Custody, folding its regulated custody business into the bank's financing and securities services division while spinning its institutional digital asset infrastructure platform into a separate SC Ventures entity, Zodia Solutions, pending regulatory approval.
